pages.title: Drag Any Node
pages.text: Drag a root or child node to place it. Descendants follow their parents. A shared child follows a nearby parent more strongly than a distant one.$(br2)Trees grow outward in eight directions from the map center. Moving a root into another direction rotates the branch, including your custom placements.

pages.title: Your Layout
pages.text: Your root positions, child offsets, expanded branches, camera, and sector-line preference are remembered for this world and character.$(br2)The client options control animation speed and minimum node size. Distant zoom reduces spacing while keeping nodes apart; your arranged positions remain saved.
